title: ChimiaClaw Lab Swarm Map
subtitle: Signed artifact kingdom view for ChimiaDAO labs, external CASP route search, precursor DFT, live ENS Sepolia identity, live 0G Galileo storage, allies, virtual swarms, and unknown laboratories.

design_language.source_reference: SciCrucible-style telemetry, sectors, swarm agents, reticles, and custody gates adapted to ChimiaClaw.
design_language.tone: low-key scientific command surface; no claim that live ORCID, KG, swarm bus, or governance execution exists yet.

current_truth: The canonical backend state is the signed artifact DAG.
This fixture is a frontend projection, not a live API response.
Current executable flows are local CLI demos over a file-backed store.

DFT entries marked real-execution include the original PBE/def2-tzvp PySCF molecule set with orbital cubes and the B3LYP/def2-svp AiZynth precursor follow-up executed on olympus.local; each chem.dft.result is signed by chimiaclaw-cli and parented to chem.dft.request plus chem.molecule.adt artifacts.
MSSP optimization and World Avatar RDF are represented as projection layers over artifacts, not as live schedulers or triple-store integrations yet.
Physical lab custody, human approval, ORCID identity, KG projection, and DAO governance are modeled as gates or future bindings unless explicitly marked implemented.
Science service market transactions are modeled as deterministic signed artifacts: ENS-shaped profile -> offer -> request -> quote -> settlement intent -> result.
Economic settlement is modeled as signed non-custodial lifecycle artifacts: quote acceptance -> escrow authorization -> settlement intent -> result acknowledgement -> release or refund.

Four lab nodes are real ChimiaDAO-operated nodes in this projection: Sofia Wetlab, Iberia Materials Bench, Analysis Dock, and Olympus DFT Worker. The remaining nodes are candidate, virtual, or quarantined endpoints.
Lab-to-lab interaction flows carry two channels where appropriate: data-driven signed artifacts and conceptual MSSP / World Avatar projections.

AiZynthFinder entries marked real-execution were run on duck@olympus.local with AiZynthFinder 4.4.1, public USPTO policy/filter models, and ZINC stock: targets 3, 4, and 5 solved; targets 1 and 2 remained unsolved under default search.

The silicon-containing TBS alcohol precursor is blocked before DFT because chimiaclaw-moladt::AtomicSymbol lacks Si support; this is represented as a model/ADT support gap, not a failed quantum-chemistry calculation.

Live sponsor integrations are represented only where backed by signed artifacts: ENS Sepolia text-record publication/resolution/verification and 0G Galileo Turbo storage upload are live; token settlement and wetlab execution remain simulated or gated unless explicitly marked otherwise.

lab_interactions.summary: Sofia shares route-intake artifacts and custody SOP deltas with Iberia so either real node can review material movement before execution.
Iberia pushes characterization intake and materials-bench observations into the Analysis Dock for signed lineage review.
Analysis Dock turns reviewed molecule artifacts into DFT requests for Olympus, with MSSP candidate scoring attached as conceptual context.
Olympus returns real PBE/def2-tzvp DFT artifacts, payload hashes, orbital cubes, and convergence metadata to Analysis Dock.
conceptual_payloads: none; this edge is data-first signed execution evidence

lab_interactions.summary: Analysis Dock asks the virtual retrosynthesis swarm to propose route families and MSSP strategy variants from verified result context.
The virtual swarm sends route proposals and quote simulations into Sofia's wetlab queue, but human safety and custody gates remain mandatory.
Sofia can share a signed collaboration proposal and non-custodial method brief with the allied flow lab while material movement remains blocked.
Allied flow-lab feedback returns as candidate validation metadata for Iberia; it is not trusted as physical execution until identity and SOP gates clear.
Unknown lab submissions can enter only as read-only claim metadata for Analysis Dock quarantine review.
conceptual_payloads: none until identity and lineage verify

lab_interactions.summary: Analysis Dock responds to the unknown lab with an audit challenge: provide identity, signature, payload hash, and parent lineage before the claim can influence the graph.
Virtual retrosynthesis planning is grounded by AiZynthFinder 4.4.1 on Olympus: five hackathon targets searched with USPTO policy/filter and ZINC stock; three solved, two open under default search.
conceptual_payloads: MSSP primitive generation from solved and unsolved route states

lab_interactions.summary: Olympus returns signed B3LYP/def2-svp DFT results for three non-silicon AiZynth precursor molecules and a fail-closed silicon support blocker for the TBS alcohol.
conceptual_payloads: none; this edge is data-first signed execution evidence plus an explicit support blocker

lab_interactions.summary: Analysis Dock publishes and resolves chimiaclaw.eth on ENS Sepolia, then signs verification artifact art_1eb873d15595ba6e with verified=true and five chimiaclaw.* records.
conceptual_payloads: AXL peer pointer and 0G root pointer publication

lab_interactions.summary: Analysis Dock anchors ferrocene MolADT source artifact art_c6fb4314b4dc7ac7 to 0G Galileo Turbo as signed upload artifact art_06b4ba819c6222bc; root hash is retained in the artifact DAG.
conceptual_payloads: storage receipt as derived proof not canonical state

trust_edges.risk_note: Physical movement still needs explicit operator signoff.
Data custody is easier than material custody but still requires provenance checks.
No automatic material transfer until identity, SOP, and safety gates are signed.
Virtual agents can draft plans but cannot claim execution.
Unknown claims stay read-only until identity, payload, and lineage are verified.
Compute results are signed and parented to a chem.molecule.adt; the analysis dock verifies signature and content hash before promoting to discourse.
Virtual swarm dispatches DFT jobs but never claims execution; olympus signs the actual result.
ENS Sepolia and 0G Galileo evidence may be publicly projected, but settlement and wetlab custody remain gated separately.

abstraction_principles.label: Artifact DAG first
abstraction_principles.description: The UI may filter, cluster, or project artifacts, but it must not invent state outside signed payload-bound lineage.

abstraction_principles.label: Custody before autonomy
abstraction_principles.description: Virtual agents may propose; physical custody and wetlab execution require human gates and explicit trust edges.

abstraction_principles.label: MSSP as genealogy
abstraction_principles.description: Optimization generations are artifact families: primitive, crossover, fitness, tournament, terminal-check, and switcher decisions become signed child artifacts.

abstraction_principles.label: World Avatar as projection
abstraction_principles.description: RDF/PROV-O/OntoChimia triples project signed artifacts into semantic space without replacing the artifact DAG as canonical state.

abstraction_principles.label: Fail closed on unknown chemistry
abstraction_principles.description: Missing identity, payload, SDS, or parent lineage should render as blocked/quarantined until reviewed.
